uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: Gains 8% of damage received as bonus Attack for 4s (maximum 200 bonus Attack from 2,500 damage received). Gain an electric charge when receiving damage, converting a portion of that damage into additional Attack.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and paralyzing opposing Pokémon hit, and restoring 10% missing HP per target hit. The movement speed of paralyzed targets is decreased by 15% for 2.5s and their auto attack speed is decreased by 25% for 1s. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and paralyzing the enemy while restoring some of Zeraora's HP.
Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and paralyzing the enemy while restoring some of Zeraora's HP.
Quickly dashes forward, and increases auto attack speed by 45% for 3s. Perform a quick dash and increase basic attack speed for a short time afterward.

Dashes forward at high speed, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path; and increasing auto attack speed by 45% for 3s. Also marks the starting location of this dash for 3s. This move can be used again within 3s to dash back to the starting location, dealing increased damage to opposing Pokémon in their path; and refreshing the auto attack speed buff duration. Perform a high-speed dash, dealing damage to enemies hit and increase basic attack speed for a short time. Using this move again within a set period of time will allow the user to immediately dash back to the original position.
Increases the damage of both dashes. Strengthens the auto attack speed increase to 60% for 3s. Increased damage and basic attack speed buff duration.

Becomes unstoppable for 0.2s and dashes forward with an electrically charged leap, damaging opposing Pokémon in their path. If an auto attack is used before the leap ends; leaps to an opposing Pokémon, dealing increased damage to the target. This move can be used again within 4s of the last use, repeating the effects of the first use (up to 3 total uses). If an auto attack is used before the leap ends, deal 110% Atk as damage instead. Leap at an enemy dealing damage to them. If using your basic attack before reaching the targeted enemy, instead leap at the closest enemy and deal damage to it. This move can be used 3 times before going on cooldown.
Restores 15% missing HP if leaping to an opposing Pokémon with an auto attack before reaching them with the dash. Also restore HP if performing a basic attack before reaching the targeted enemy.

Pounces toward the designated opposing Pokémon's location and attacks with 3 sharp claw swipes, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and throwing those hit by the last swipe for 0.5s. Pounce at an enemy and attack with sharp claws. This move's final attack throws enemies.

Discharges electricity around themself for 1.5s, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area of effect every 0.3s (up to 6 times), followed by a final discharge after 0.4s; granting a shield for 3s when this move hits. Pulls opposing Pokémon paralyzed by the user hit by the final discharge in toward Zeraora's position over 1s, stunning them for 1s during the pull; and dealing extra damage to them. Release an electrical discharge, dealing damage to nearby enemies and grant the user a shield when it hits. If this move hits enemies that are paralyzed, it pulls them in toward the user once the move ends, dealing damage to them once again and leaving them unable to act.
Decreases the movement speed of opposing Pokémon by 25% for 1s when hit. Decreases movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits.

Dashes forward. If this move hits an opposing Pokémon; latches onto the target, and becomes untargetable to unleash a combo of at least 3 attacks, damaging the target with each attack (switching to the closest opposing Pokémon if the target is out of range or unable to be attacked for the next attack). Receives 1% remaining HP recoil damage per attack; the initial hit deals 2 instances of recoil damage. Opposing Pokémon hit by one of these attacks receive 50% reduced damage from subsequent attacks from Wild Charge for 5s. Hitting an opposing Pokémon with boosted attacks, Volt Switch, or Spark applies 1 stack of a Wild Charge buff for 5s (up to 3 stacks); each stack of the buff adds 1 additional attack to the next use of Wild Charge (for up to 6 total hits). Zeraora is untargetable while attacking; for 1.2s at 0 stacks, 1.5s at 1 stack, 1.8s at 2 stacks and 2s at 3 stacks from this buff. Deals half damage. Charge in the designated direction. If this move hits an enemy, unleash a combo attack that also deals a set amount of damage to itself. If the user hit an enemy with Volt Switch, Spark, or a boosted attack before using this move, the number of attacks in the combo is increased.
Deals 50% reduced damage to other nearby opposing Pokémon with each attack. Also deals damage to nearby enemies when this hits.

Becomes unstoppable for 0.5s and launches a bolt of lightning toward the designated target; damaging opposing Pokémon in its path toward the target and throwing them for 0.5s. Once the bolt reaches the target; damages opposing Pokémon in an area of effect and throws them once again. Creates a circular zone of plasma centered on the target's location for 5s when it hits; paralyzing opposing Pokémon inside it for 3s. While in the zone, also increases the user's auto attack range, and auto attack damage by 20%. Unleash a blast of lightning, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and throw them. This also creates a zone of plasma that increases the user's basic attack range and damage dealt while inside this zone.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 20% Attack Speed, 15% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
